launch_objective: A serious, fast, local-first triathlon world where users can enter as guests, understand the product immediately, explore the 14 founding rooms, discover/collect meaningful artifacts, personalize their race identity and return without losing state.
blockers: consumer identity and deployment origin are coherent
state persistence and legacy compatibility are proven
14 founding rooms are reachable without contradictory XP room gating
Founding 141 registry is stable and launch subset is obtainable
WebGL fallback and navigation recovery work

public_claim_rules.rule: Say geometry study unless exact/CAD provenance is documented.
Label first-order estimates and uncertainty; do not claim wind-tunnel/CFD precision without evidence.
Local-first is accurate; do not call storage cryptographic unless it is.
Headless browser evidence is not physical-device certification.
No sacred/restricted Hawaiian object or deity-based gamification without qualified cultural review.
